versions.content: Bit 3 of the NetworkStateFlexRay shall contain the Syntax Error state. This is an aggregated error flag of the FlexRay channels that is related to the channel assignment of the FrameID , but not to a source frame and its FrameID that is reported in the same data item. It may also be reported in a data item where the PayloadAvailable field is set to 0 and the FrameIDAvailable is set to 1 with the slot valid flag of the FrameID set to 0 . The Syntax Error state shall be set to 1 once after a FlexRay controller detected a syntax error. Otherwise it shall be set to 0 .
